subject: storytime
title: Stellaluna words
about: A baby fruit bat lands in a nest of birds and tries to live the way they do, until she finds her own kind and learns that friends can be different. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Janell Cannon
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A lost baby bat raised by birds finds out who she really is and keeps her friends anyway.

cards.note: capital S, it is her name; four parts: Stel-la-lu-na, the lu says loo
o says u, like in other: muth-er
ow says ou as in out, like in cow
all regular; s-t at the end
ir says er, like in her; the s says z
f-r blend; ui says oo, like in moon: froot
two words: up + side; magic e makes i say its name
ow says ou as in out
igh is one part and says long i
t-r blend, then ee says long e
